<json>{
  "states": [
    "ConnectionOpened",
    "AwaitingClientInitiation",
    "SessionEstablished",
    "MailTransactionStart",
    "RecipientsSpecified",
    "DataTransferInProgress",
    "TransactionComplete",
    "SessionTerminated"
  ],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "ConnectionOpened",
      "event": "send greeting",
      "action": "reply 220 or 554",
      "to": "AwaitingClientInitiation"
    },
    {
      "from": "AwaitingClientInitiation",
      "event": "receive EHLO",
      "action": "reply extended response",
      "to": "SessionEstablished"
    },
    {
      "from": "AwaitingClientInitiation",
      "event": "receive HELO",
      "action": "reply standard response",
      "to": "SessionEstablished"
    },
    {
      "from": "SessionEstablished",
      "event": "receive MAIL FROM",
      "action": "reply 250 OK",
      "to": "MailTransactionStart"
    },
    {
      "from": "MailTransactionStart",
      "event": "receive RCPT TO",
      "action": "reply 250 OK or 550",
      "to": "RecipientsSpecified"
    },
    {
      "from": "RecipientsSpecified",
      "event": "receive DATA",
      "action": "reply 354 Intermediate",
      "to": "DataTransferInProgress"
    },
    {
      "from": "DataTransferInProgress",
      "event": "receive end of data indicator",
      "action": "reply 250 OK",
      "to": "TransactionComplete"
    },
    {
      "from": "SessionEstablished",
      "event": "receive VRFY",
      "action": "reply 250 or 553",
      "to": "SessionEstablished"
    },
    {
      "from": "SessionEstablished",
      "event": "receive EXPN",
      "action": "reply 250 multiline or 550",
      "to": "SessionEstablished"
    },
    {
      "from": "TransactionComplete",
      "event": "receive QUIT",
      "action": "reply 221",
      "to": "SessionTerminated"
    },
    {
      "from": "AwaitingClientInitiation",
      "event": "timeout waiting for command",
      "action": "close connection",
      "to": "SessionTerminated"
    }
  ]
}</json>
